reviews.text: We use both the LA and SD Pupper Club and really trust no one else with our Doodle Charlie! He's both stayed for long term boarding in the San Diego location and been groomed at both locations. One of the best services they have in the San Diego location is that an attendant is there 24/7 making sure everyone is ok and giving some extra love if needed. They keep us updated with pics and videos and constant communication. Other facilities never really sent pictures to us and few updates so Pupperclub is a refreshing change.  Besides the services the location is perfectly safe and secure. The facility is extremely clean and welcoming. I also love that it is a safe and secure space with someone always present.  When it comes to grooming, our boy likes to swim in the lake and they are miracle workers with matting :) Highly recommend!

The neighborhood is really bad. Homeless coming up  asking for money.This company is way over priced and their excuse is because San Diego is very expensive this is true but the neighborhood this company is in is 100 % Ghetto and shouldn't be charging so much.It was a one time thing never again..😡 …

This review is LONG overdue-
I have been taking my dog Mavis here since she was a puppy. I highly recommend socializing, and prefer this safe environment over dog parks. She absolutely loves it here and comes home completely pupped out lol.
The staff is attentive and friendly. They share pictures every couple hours. Drop off and pick-ups are easy and quick.
The grooming is always Top Notch. Even when playing all day, she doesn't come home smelling like dogs.
They also give out FREE food samples from a partnering company.
3 years of back to back satisfaction and consistent customer service !
Thank you Pupper Club :)

I give this place less than 0 stars.  When I made the appt they told me it was no problem that my dog was not neutered.  Upon arrival from out of state, they would not accept my dog because of that reason.  We planned our trip around this relying on our dog to be taken care of and since it was the Fourth of July, no other place was available so this was a major inconvenience.  They were highly unprofessional and I’m dissatisfied.

My dog gets excited every time we arrive, which says everything about the positive experience she has there. I love knowing she’s spending her day in a safe, clean, and fun environment with plenty of attention, exercise, and socialization. The staff always keeps me updated and treats my dog as if she were their own.

I’ve been testing out different dog day cares based on the area I need to be in for the day and this is officially one of my new favorites. They made it very easy to come in last minute for my first time. After looking at his paperwork and quickly making me a profile the amazing girl at the front desk, Percy, let me know that his first day would be free. Which was really nice in general, not to mention the fact that a different doggy daycare in La Jolla had charged me a fee for bringing him in for his first day because they “pay extra attention”. That location closes at 5 and had one other dog and this amazing puppet club had about ten dogs on their small side at the time and closes at 8pm then does boarding as well. I always want him to be with other dogs and not locked in a crate and you know that that is happening here with their updated live photos through your account and the pure attention that I was shown through just one employee, Percy.

We boarded our dog Bodhi at Pupper Club San Diego and had an absolutely wonderful experience. The staff were caring, communicative, and sent photo text updates throughout his stay so we never had to wonder how he was doing. Bodhi came home happy, tired from playing and tail-wagging. The facility is clean, the team clearly loves animals, and the whole experience gave us total peace of mind. If you're looking for a boarding spot in San Diego that truly treats your dog like family, Pupper Club is it. We'll be back without question! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Hands down, best dog daycare and boarding facility I’ve tried in San Diego! They send lots of updates and photos throughout the stay, which makes me feel really secure about leaving my baby with them! Have used grooming once so far and best doodle groom by far!

My dog was in another daycare facility, which she didn't seem to be enjoying. The videos I saw were of her just standing around and not playing. I brought her to Pupper Club for a meet and greet. They sent pictures of her having the best time and interacting with the other dogs. She was smiling and having so much fun. The staff was so friendly and positive which made a world of difference for her, and me. Look at that happy girl! With her new boyfriend ;-) Pupper Club is the club to be at!

The Pupper Club did such a wonderful job taking care of my dog! There were lots of personal updates and you can tell the staff enjoyed interacting with him. This is the place to go with your pup. Mine will certainly be back!
Its good. This is my dog sitting place of choice.

My pup absolutely loves this place! He is always well cared for while he’s there. We enjoy the frequent photos and updates. It’s so convenient to be able to text with staff if needed! Definitely recommend!

We love Pupper club! All of the staff are so friendly and kind. My puppy absolutely loves coming, we get frequent updates all day, and I especially appreciate how staff seem to truly care about my girl. Thank you so much Pupper club!

I’ve been bringing my dog Leo here for over two years—ever since I rescued him—and I honestly couldn’t recommend this place more! Leo is very stubborn and not the easiest pup when it comes to baths or especially nail trims, but the staff here is incredibly patient and gentle. Somehow, they manage to get Leo to relax and actually let them bathe him and trim his nails, which is nothing short of a miracle!

More recently, I started using their walking services because of my busy work schedule, and they have been amazing. They pick Leo up, drop him off, are very flexible with timing, and Leo is always happy and full of energy when he comes back. It gives me total peace of mind knowing he’s in such good hands.

This team truly cares about the animals they work with, and Leo absolutely loves them. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy, loving, and professional place for grooming and dog walking!
I totally highly recommend Pupper Club for your fur baby.  They listen to what I wanted and made sure that she came out looking like I explained,  Thank you for making Izzy so cute!!

I’ve sent my dog, Ozzy, to a few daycare places across California and this is one of the best ones I’ve used. When I drop him off, my anxious dog doesn’t look back — which is indicative of how much he loves going there. The staff is also very friendly and they text me photos and updates throughout the day, which includes staff petting him. I love knowing he’s in such good loving hands. I never have to worry that he’s kept in a cage or is forced to sit around all day. He gets to play all day long.
Boarded my dog here and since then my dog has never been the same. Severely traumatized.

I have an anxious blind and deaf senior shih tzu.  They were absolutely wonderful with her!! So sweet and caring. Great at communicating, helpful and detailed when I called midday for an update, and soooo patient and loving with my dog. I appreciate it! We'll def be back!

First time bringing my dog here for daycare. Dont be put off by the surrounding area. The facility is clean, secure, and the staff are friendly and helpful. I appreciate all the updates while my dog was in daycare.
“Love Pupper Club! Louie, my golden doodle, has an amazing time every visit and absolutely loves all the attention he gets.”
Took my Frida today to be assessed. Frida had a super great time. The staff were very attentive. Super sweet. I’m in love with them. Frida too ❤️

I can’t say enough good things about this daycare, my dog is absolutely obsessed! She gets SO excited the second we walk through the door and goes wild anytime she sees one of the staff members (even if we’re just passing them outside on a walk!). It’s the cutest thing ever and such a testament to how much she loves it there.

The team is amazing—super friendly, clearly love the dogs, and they send tons of photo updates throughout the day, which I love. I always feel at ease knowing she’s having a great time with her friends and in good hands.

I live in the apartment building next door, so the location is incredibly convenient, and they even pick her up or drop her off when I’m at work. Seriously, the level of care and attention they give is above and beyond. Highly recommend to any fellow dog parents!

My pup is very shy, but the staff at Pupper Club are incredibly kind and patient with her. It means so much to see her come out of her shell and actually enjoy herself! She always has a great time playing with the other doggos, and I feel completely at ease knowing she’s in such caring hands. Highly recommend for anyone with a more timid pup!
Great staff, door to door service, my dog is very anxious but they take care of her well and I can trust pupper club to take care of her.

Pupper Club staff have been great to us in helping schedule  grooming, giving us great deals on doggie day care.  Even picking my babies up when I did not have my car. If you are looking for a terrific place who cares about your pets and do a great job with the grooming and pay attention to your individual pet needs.  I have been using this company for several years, and I am very happy.
My pups favorite doggy day care. And the grooming is also great. They make him feel comfortable and updated texts with pictures let me know he’s having a good time!

I thank each and every one who shared in the overnight stay and daily care of Kobe. I had daily reports 3x's out of the day or more. Kobe was able to hear my voice on a phone call. I thank you all truly and appreciate the love you gave my baby. Excellent service would recommend highly ❤️🐶❤️ …
This place is great!  My pup looks forward to going.  They get to know the dogs and I trust them.  Been very happy with my experience.  Grooming is great took!

My Millie Jo absolutely loves coming here and we love the staff! They always know how to make her feel special and we have boarded her here for an extended period and felt like our baby girl was in great hands.

We love Pupper Club, almost as much as our girl Josie! We’ve been taking her here for several years now and all of the employees are so kind and welcoming. Josie doesn’t even say goodbye to us when we drop her off anymore, she just runs in without looking back 😢. Our favorite thing Pupper Club does is send us photos of Josie while she’s partying at club and whenever she’s eating her meals. Would recommend Pupper Club to all San Diego dog owners!

Louie is absolutely spoiled by everyone at PupperClub!  Love all pics and updates I get throughout the day. Louie absolutely loves it here.  Feel very comfortable leaving him at Pupper Club overnight.

I love Pupper Club. I tried some other daycares and I feel most comfortable with Pupper Club! Piper has been going since she was a Puppy & she loves it. I don’t have to worry about anything when she is there & I pick up a tired and happy pup afterwards. Staff is wonderful!

I wouldn't trust anyone else with my precious pooch Indy. They take amazing care of her when I am out of town or have a business meeting. I now groom her every 3 weeks as well and she looks adorable. A day later she is running around in the mud, but that's her style. Thankfully I can bring her in and they do an amazing job!

We just recently moved to Downtown San Diego and so lucky to have found Pupper Club! They are a few blocks from our apartment building, which is super convenient as they pick up and drop off in the neighborhood as well as walks! We use Pupper for Daycare and Boarding and will try grooming soon too! Our baby Lola absolutely loves it there, can’t say enough good things :)

I am grateful to the PupperClub fam. Going back to the office was less stressful knowing my fur baby has a safe place to go to and where she is loved. I enjoy the picture updates through the day and how responsive the team is if I have any questions. Thank you PupperClub fam.
My dog Han loves it here when he comes for boarding. He always looks so happy in all in the updates they give. The staff is always super responsive to messages. My go to for dog sitting my fur baby

Best doggy daycare and boarding experience I’ve had in San Diego. They are super communicative, the space is clean and really cute and never ever overcrowded, which makes me feel much safer leaving my dog there, than in a more chaotic setting. Highly recommend!

We joined Pupper Club after moving to downtown from Oceanside. We were regulars at a daycare up there but wanted to continue having our girl go to a daycare down here - and that's when we found Pupper Club! From day one, we were blown away with the clubs communication with us. We get frequent texts during the day with photos and updates on our girl and her fun activities! She always is running around and having a blast. It brings me so much joy to physically see her perk up and get a pep in her step when she knows we're walking her there in the mornings. All of the staff are lovely and so helpful with booking requests. I give a wholehearted recommendation for Pupper Club.

Pupper Club was AMAZING to work with and all were very communicative, accommodating, and understanding. We boarded our pup for a little over 24 hours, and they sent lots of updates and pics of her playing. They were also very accommodating …

I am at a loss for words. Eileen and her ABOVE AND BEYOND staff go that extra 10 miles. My dog is happier there than at home I think sometimes. I can do whatever I need to,worry free,knowing Dolce' is at "The Club". Thank you Pupper Club..we 💕 you …
Edited: the groomer reached out to us personally to settle our fears. Thank you! …

Id like to start by saying Our girl Olive really likes the staff! Tail wagging and all!  She is a rescue and is really sweet. This is our first time apart from her, and we are currently on vacation, but we feel that she's in good hands! …
I started bringing my pups to Pupper Club and love their daycare for my little one. I also started grooming services and she looks adorable. 5 Stars! Love Pupper Club!

Pupper club has been such a blessing for our family. Our dog absolutely loves going, and we have had nothing but positive experiences with the staff. They are always in communication with us, sending photos and updates and are always so …

My pups (Honey and Dom) and I love the Pupper Club and could not recommend it more! I use them for boarding, daycare and grooming. I love that they send me text messages throughout the day with pictures and updates on how my pups are doing. …

My dog has gone there for grooming, boarding and daycare. I have always been pleased by the services and my dog loves it there. Really appreciate that they can provide special care, and always enjoy the photos and texts of her visits.
We love taking our dog to Pupper Club! They send lots of photos throughout the day and are quick to respond to any questions!
